title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Uruguayan Mustard Sauce
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring pan-seared snapper topped with a tangy Uruguayan mustard sauce.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the snapper fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the Uruguayan mustard and lime juice in a small bowl.
Serve the snapper fillets with the Uruguayan mustard sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
